found: [backend] GET /ordering/bookings/:id answers no order_group_id and no sibling bookings, so the page shows only the one booking (own status, own payment, own refund). A split group is reached through one link per booking on the confirm screen; there is no combined tracking list.
suspect: Needs order_group_id and the sibling booking ids on the view answer.

found: [backend] The booking and approval answers carry catalogue ids only. The page looks the name up in the public lab catalogue (page.tsx itemNames); radiology and nursing ids, or an id the catalogue no longer knows, show "Item n".
suspect: Needs name_ar/name_en on the items of GET /ordering/bookings/:id and /approval.

found: [backend] The pending approval answer has no expected reply time or deadline, so the board's clock for the insurer is not drawn; only the estimate, the wait text and the home-visit note are.
suspect: Needs an expected_reply_at (or similar) on the pending approval view.

found: [client] The warning and the rebook link appear only when the server sets warning and rebook_earlier (after a decision). The link opens the labs hub because the booking has no quote context to reopen the time picker with.
suspect: Needs the old quote or a reschedule endpoint to open the time picker for the same items.

found: [backend] The view answers refund_status only (no refund amount), so the text says that a refund of what was paid has started, with no figure. The board shows the SAR amount.

found: [backend] The view has no cancel reason: a provider timeout, a patient "cancel for free" and any other cancel look the same. The "provider did not confirm" title is shown only when the server sent an alternative; otherwise the title is the plain Cancelled.

found: [backend] The alternative is {provider_id, total, earliest_at}: no provider name and no quote, so the page shows price and earliest time and the "See other providers" link to the labs hub; the board's "Book with this provider" and its provider name are not drawn.

found: [backend] The board offers "Cancel booking" with free cancellation, but the view does not say whether cancelling is free or what the fee is (POST /labs/bookings/:id/cancel exists). No cancel button is built, so the patient is never promised a fee-free cancel the server did not state.
